# MediaFrame

Image / video in a rounded, aspect-locked tile.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.MediaFrame` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.MediaFrame />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.MediaFrame"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Rounded media tile with fixed aspect ratio, images, video with play/mute, case-study covers with overlay titles.

## Props (MediaFrameProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | Image or video URL. Omit for a striped placeholder. |
| `poster` | `string` | Video poster image. |
| `alt` | `string` | Alt text (image) / placeholder label. |
| `ratio` | `string` | CSS aspect-ratio. @default "16 / 9" |
| `video` | `boolean` | Treat `src` as a video with play / mute controls. @default false |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | Autoplay muted (video only). @default false |
| `loop` | `boolean` | @default true |
| `caption` | `React.ReactNode` | Caption under the frame. |
| `radius` | `string` | Corner radius. @default "var(--radius-xl)" |
| `fit` | `'cover' \| 'contain'` | object-fit. @default "cover" |
| `overlay` | `React.ReactNode` | Content pinned to the bottom inline-start corner over a navy gradient scrim (titles on covers). |
| `errorLabel` | `string` | What a failed image says (it also offers Try again). @default "This image didn't load" |
| `onError` | `(e: React.SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement>) => void` | Called when the image fails to load. |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
